instruction:
Use the ANSYS Mechanical APDL GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: 3D solid cantilever beam under an end concentrated force.

Model parameters:
- Beam cross section 10 mm x 10 mm, length 100 mm
- Material: linear elastic steel, E = 210000 MPa, nu = 0.3
- Element: SOLID185
- Mesh: global element size 5 mm

Boundary conditions and load:
- Fixed end: fully constrained
- Top midpoint of free end: concentrated force 100 N in the -Y direction

Analysis type: static analysis

Save requirements:
- Database file: apdl_solid_beam.db
- Result file (.rst) must exist in the working directory
